description: Interlock Claude Code lockdown settings - evidence-first, fail-closed

bash.description: Only allow execution of vetted wrapper scripts in ./scripts/claude/

read.description: Read repo files only, never secrets or system paths

write.description: Write only to Claude artifacts and config, never secrets or CI

glob.description: Glob repo files, skip heavy directories

grep.description: Search repo files, skip heavy directories

behavior.description: Fail-closed: deny beats allow, require evidence for claims

notes: All automation MUST go through ./scripts/claude/ wrappers
Arbitrary shell execution is NOT permitted
Every operation should emit artifacts for audit
Deny rules take precedence over allow rules
